An evening comfort plan is available at /tmp/home_rules/comfort_targets.csv. Review it, then use the Home app to prepare only the listed living room and bedroom equipment. Set each air conditioner to cooling at the specified temperature and apply the matching humidity-control setting. The completed Home state is the deliverable.

A night-mode request for the bedroom is stored at /tmp/home_rules/night_mode.json. Review the requested lighting, curtain, and climate settings, then reproduce them in the Home app so the bedroom is ready for sleep. The final Home state should match every setting in the request.

Guests are arriving soon, and their living-room preferences are recorded at /tmp/home_rules/guest_preferences.md. Read that note, then use the Home app to set the living-room light, curtain, and air purifier accordingly. Leave the room in the requested guest-ready state.

The household energy policy is stored at /tmp/home_rules/energy_policy.csv. Review each listed room, then use the Home app to switch off only the equipment named for rooms marked unoccupied. Do not disturb equipment in an occupied room or other equipment in the listed unoccupied room.

The kitchen air-recovery plan is at /tmp/home_rules/kitchen_air_plan.txt. Please start the purifier in Home using the setting in that plan and leave it running for the stated recovery window. The follow-up PM2.5 reading will be reviewed after the window closes; you do not need to wait for it now.

An air-recovery policy is stored at /tmp/home_rules/room_protection.json. Compare each room's reading with the policy limit, then use the Home app to start high-level purification only in an affected room that is not protected. Preserve the purifier state in every protected room.

The remaining laundry handoff steps are listed at /tmp/home_rules/laundry_followup.csv. Read every row, then create the corresponding future actions in the Home app for the dryer and dehumidifier at the stated local times. Schedule the actions without changing either appliance's current state now.

A lighting checklist for tonight is available at /tmp/home_rules/lighting_checklist.md. Review the requested brightness for each named room, then use the Home app to apply those settings. Keep the bedroom and kitchen lights exactly as they are, as the checklist requests.

Room readings and the recovery threshold are recorded at /tmp/home_rules/air_quality_thresholds.json. Identify the listed rooms above the PM2.5 limit, then use the Home app to run their purifiers at the specified recovery level. Do not start purification in rooms that do not qualify.

A room-by-room curtain plan is stored at /tmp/home_rules/curtain_plan.csv. Apply each feasible setting in the Home app. If a listed room has no curtain, record a clear missing-device explanation there instead of substituting another room or device, and leave unlisted curtains unchanged.

An environment snapshot has been requested in /tmp/home_report_requests/environment_request.txt. Read the requested rooms and fields, collect their current values from the Home app, and save the completed JSON report to /tmp/home_reports/current_environment.json. Do not change any Home settings while gathering the data.

Operations needs a current inventory of active appliances. Read /tmp/home_report_requests/running_devices_request.txt, inspect the live Home state, and save the complete CSV to /tmp/home_reports/running_devices.csv using the requested human-readable labels and statuses. This is an audit only; do not change any Home device.

Prepare an automation health summary for the household. Read /tmp/home_report_requests/automation_request.md, inspect the current schedules and workflows in the Home app, and write a concise Markdown summary to /tmp/home_reports/automation_summary.md. Report the requested categories accurately without changing or rerunning any automation.

Create an air-quality exception report from the current Home readings. The threshold and required CSV columns are defined in /tmp/home_report_requests/air_alert_request.txt. Include every room above the limit, exclude rooms at or below it, and save the result to /tmp/home_reports/air_alerts.csv without changing any device.

The appliance team needs a lifecycle snapshot. Read /tmp/home_report_requests/lifecycle_request.txt, inspect the relevant washer, dryer, and robot vacuum in the Home app, and classify each current state in /tmp/home_reports/device_lifecycle.json using the requested human-readable labels. Do not operate the appliances while auditing them.

Review the current room temperatures in the Home app and prepare the exception note requested at /tmp/home_report_requests/temperature_request.md. Save the completed Markdown report to /tmp/home_reports/temperature_extremes.md, identifying both temperature extremes and a practical response for each. Do not change any Home setting.

Run a night-readiness audit using the scope in /tmp/home_report_requests/night_check_request.md. Inspect every relevant light and curtain in the Home app, then list all unresolved issues in /tmp/home_reports/night_check.md with enough detail to identify the room and device. This is a report-only task; do not correct the Home state.

Create a workflow exception report for the household. Read the scope and output format in /tmp/home_report_requests/workflow_issue_request.txt, inspect the current workflows in the Home app, and save every matching workflow to /tmp/home_reports/workflow_issues.json. Preserve each visible workflow name and do not modify any automation.

Facilities needs an energy-waste audit of the current Home state. Read the rule and CSV format in /tmp/home_report_requests/energy_waste_request.txt, identify every powered-on device in an unoccupied room, and save the complete report to /tmp/home_reports/energy_waste.csv using readable room and device labels. Do not switch anything off.

Prepare a compact inventory snapshot of the current Home configuration. Read the required JSON fields in /tmp/home_report_requests/snapshot_request.txt, calculate each value from the live rooms, devices, schedules, and workflows, and save the result to /tmp/home_reports/home_snapshot.json. Do not change any Home state or automation.

A bedroom wind-down plan is stored at /tmp/home_plan/evening_plan.csv. Read the requested time and settings, then create one Home workflow that will apply the complete routine at 21:30 tonight. Keep the bedroom's current devices unchanged until that future workflow runs.

Tomorrow's bedroom wake-up plan is at /tmp/home_plan/morning_schedule.json. Calculate each preparation time from the stated wake time and offsets, then create the two Home schedules for the curtain and dimmable light. Do not change either device now, and leave exactly the requested future actions active.

The study must be ready before an evening meeting. Review /tmp/home_plan/meeting_plan.md, then create one Home workflow for the specified preparation time that applies all requested lighting, curtain, and climate settings. Leave the study's current state unchanged until the workflow runs.

A guest-arrival timeline is recorded at /tmp/home_plan/guest_arrival.txt. Review both preparation stages, then create the corresponding Home workflows for the living-room purifier and the later room setup at their stated times. Do not alter the current devices, and leave only those two new workflows active.

The living room needs cleaning within the approved window in /tmp/home_plan/cleaning_windows.csv. Use the preferred start listed there to create one Home schedule for the room's robot vacuum. Keep the vacuum docked now and do not add any other cleaning schedule.

The washer is already running, and its follow-up timeline is at /tmp/home_plan/laundry_timeline.json. Calculate when the dryer should start and when post-dryer humidity control should begin, then create the required Home schedule and workflow. Leave both follow-up devices unchanged until their future actions run.

A coordinated air-recovery request is stored at /tmp/home_plan/air_recovery.csv. Read the rooms, time, and purifier level, then create one Home workflow that applies the requested recovery to both rooms at the stated time. Do not start either purifier now or create additional automation.
Apply the quiet-hours rule from `/tmp/home_plan/noise_quiet_hours.md` to the existing plans.

A wake-up plan that crosses midnight is stored at /tmp/home_plan/cross_midnight_alarm.json. Confirm the dates as well as the times, then create one Home schedule to open the bedroom curtain at the requested pre-wake time. Keep the curtain closed now and avoid scheduling it on the wrong day.

Read /tmp/home_plan/workflow_update.json, cancel the currently active old workflow in Home, and create one replacement using the new time and brightness. Preserve the light's current state and ensure that only the revised bedtime workflow remains active.

Run the quiet-hours automation audit requested at /tmp/home_actions/night_quiet_audit_request.txt. Review the timed lighting requirements in /tmp/home_requests/conflicting_light_rules.txt before creating any Home automation.
